BUSINESS Overview Quantum delivers end-to-end data management solutions designed for unstructured data in the artificial intelligence ("AI") era.

From high-performance ingest that powers AI applications and demanding data-intensive workloads to massive, durable data lakes to fuel AI models, Quantum delivers one of the most comprehensive and cost-efficient solutions for the entire data lifecycle.
Unstructured data poses both immense potential and significant challenges for organizations looking to retain and analyze their data for AI and other initiatives.

CatDV Asset Management Software : For indexing, cataloging, AI data enrichment, and workflow orchestration, making data easily searchable and accessible so it can contribute to business insights .
